verdict.rationale: Ollama's own marketing says prompts are never tracked and that nothing run locally leaves the machine, which implies there is no local telemetry to opt out of. However, no explicit telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control is documented, and the claim covers prompts rather than usage data in general, including on the cloud offering. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, a statement of what usage data cloud usage collects, and independent verification that no telemetry is sent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
